{{Quote|Leave what you have found, and we won't kill you.|Osia, to the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="CA" />}}
'''Osia''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Osia was among a team of Believers dispatched to a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret base]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]] to survey the results of a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus]] released by the cult within the facility. Upon arrival at the base, the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] fell under attack from the deranged [[mutant]] [[Caarite]] [[Ko Bas]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] four of their party and leaving only Osia and the Believer [[Aris (Human)|Aris]] alive. Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, the two Believers ambushed a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] at the base and were defeated by them.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Kill them!|Osia, urging the Caarites U and G to attack the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="CA" />}}
Osia was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="CA" /> Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Osia was among a group of six Believers summoned to rendezvous at a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the floating [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Tolea Biqua]]<ref name="CA" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]<ref name="LFCG" /> in preparation for an upcoming mission. Two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] prior, the cult had staged the release of an [[Anti-Caarite virus|experimental new virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]] at a [[Metatheran Cartel Tilnes base|secret base]] of the [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]]. Osia and his comrades were tasked with review the results of the virus on the inhabitants of the base; Osia was briefed only on the essential details of the assignment and was left unaware of how the group to communicate the strike team's findings or of the Believers' wider plans to use the virus to cripple the Metatheran Cartel.<ref name="CA" />

The [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] journeyed to Tilnes aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and made their way to the Cartel facility, which was situated within a tunnel network deep beneath the moon's surface. Shortly after their arrival at the base, an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] emitted from the core of Tilnes struck the facility, activating an emergency a security protocol that sealed the doors, trapping Osia and his comrades within. The Believers soon found that not all of the base's inhabitants had been killed by the virus; the Caarite [[Ko Bas]] had been transformed by the contagion into a grotesque [[mutant]] being and attacked Osia and the other cultists. Bas killed four of the slower members of their party, while Osia and the Believer Aris evaded his clutches and fled into the depths of the Cartel facility in search of a safe place to hide.<ref name="CA" />

Osia and Aris took refuge inside a concealed security office and encountered there two other mutant Caarites, [[U]] and [[G]]. Through use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Mind trick/Legends|influence their minds]] and also by speaking to the mutants in their [[Caarimala|native Caarite language]], the two Believers subdued the mutants and brought them under their control. Osia and Aris subsequently tried to bypass the base's security system to allow them to leave the Cartel facility, but their attempts were unsuccessful.<ref name="CA" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]''}}
Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] after Osia's arrived at the Cartel base, the [[heroes of Cularin]]&ndash;a renowned group of freelance agents&ndash;entered the facility while investigating a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. Their arrival took the Believers by surprise and Osia and Aris watched on unseen as the operatives fought and overcame Ko Bas and recovered an active specimen of the viral contagion. The Believer pair resolved to prevent the operatives from leaving the base so as to ensure that knowledge of the pathogen remained a closely guarded secret.<ref name="CA" />

Accompanied by U and G, Osia and Aris confronted the heroes of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] at the entrance to the base as the agents attempted to leave. They revealed themselves to the operatives and Osia issued an ultimatum that the agents either surrender their virus sample and leave unharmed or be killed. The heroes of Cularin refused to hand over the viral specimen and Osia and Aris attacked them while urging the two mutant Caarites to slay the agents. However, the Believers were defeated, allowing the heroes of Cularin to take the virus sample away for analysis.<ref name="CA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A devoted adherent to the ideology of the Believers, Osia considered that death and destruction would come to the enemies of the cult. As was commonplace among the Believers, on his right shoulder he had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] depicting the spire of the [[Almas Sith fortress|Sith fortress]] on the planet [[Almas]].<ref name="CA" />

==Powers and abilities==
Osia was proficient in various Force powers including the abilities to sense things, perform mind tricks, [[Enhance Attribute|enhance his physical attributes]] and to heal himself and others. In addition to Basic, he could speak the language Caarite.<ref name="CA" />

==Equipment==
During his assignment to Tilnes, Osia wielded a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]]. He was also equipped with a [[blast helmet]] and [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]], as well as a [[Breath mask/Legends|respirator]] to prevent him from contracting the anti-Caarite virus.<ref name="CA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Osia was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and featured in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Caaried Away|Caaried Away]]'', [[March]] [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign and served as the first instalment of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]]. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the heroes of Cularin and if the player characters acquiesce to Osia's demand to hand over their specimen of the anti-Caarite virus, Osia and Aris allow the agents to depart the unhindered. After the operatives have left, two Believers then make their way through a different set of tunnels to the agents up to the surface of Tilnes and head to the cultists' starship.<ref name="CA" />

If the players refuse to surrender the virus, Osia and Aris attack them and it is possible for Osia to be incapacitated or killed. If he is captured, he attempts to commit suicide by strangling himself with the Force. If the player characters succeed at preventing him from killing himself it is possible for them to persuade him to provide them information about the Believers' mission. If Osia and Aris defeat the freelance agents, they collect the viral sample and depart the base accompanied by the mutant Caarites U and G, leaving the player characters alive as the cultists had no orders to kill any non-Caarites.<ref name="CA" />
